title: Cinder Toffee
preamble:
Ingredients:-
25g
butter
100g
sugar
2
tablespoons golden syrup
1
level teaspoon bicarbonate of soda

25g
butter
100g
sugar
2
tablespoons golden syrup
1
level teaspoon bicarbonate of soda

Method:-
Grease a baking tin ready for the toffee.
Put butter, sugar and golden syrup into a heavy-based saucepan and heat slowly until butter has melted and sugar dissolved.
Allow to boil whilst stirring continuously.
Then boil rapidly WITHOUT stirring for 5 minutes
Remove from heat and stir in the bicarbonate of soda.
Pour the frothing mixture into the tin and allow to cool.
Mark into squares as it cools and break into pieces when brittle.
